dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「なんか、あんたがいると卒業式が終わったっ
　て気がしないんだけど」
dialogues.en:
I called Koyomi-sensei yesterday to ask if Miharu could take
a day off today.
dialogues.text:
I called Koyomi-sensei yesterday to ask if Miharu could take
a day off today.

dialogues.jp: 先生がわざと俺のほうにケムリを吐く。
dialogues.en:
I'm not sure how much it helps, but I just didn't want an
accident to happen at school.
dialogues.text:
I'm not sure how much it helps, but I just didn't want an
accident to happen at school.

dialogues.jp:
「げふ、げふ。それで、今日は美春はちゃんと
　休んでますよね？」
dialogues.en: The end of the semester is only a few days away.
dialogues.text: The end of the semester is only a few days away.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「昨日、朝倉から電話があったとおり、ちゃん
　と休ませてるよ」
dialogues.en: "So, is it true that she got some of her memories back?"
dialogues.text: "So, is it true that she got some of her memories back?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、昨日のうちに先生に連絡を取り、美春を
休ませるようにお願いしたのだ。
dialogues.en:
I told Koyomi-sensei about what had happened the other day,
except for that one thing...
dialogues.text:
I told Koyomi-sensei about what had happened the other day,
except for that one thing...

dialogues.jp:
焼け石に水かも知れないけれど、少なくとも学
園で事故が起こらないようにはしたい。
dialogues.en:
"It sounds very strange that only one particular memory only
came back to her."
dialogues.text:
"It sounds very strange that only one particular memory only
came back to her."

dialogues.jp: 三学期もあと、数日なのだから。
dialogues.en: "It turned out that it's her most important memory."
dialogues.text: "It turned out that it's her most important memory."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「結局、記憶が戻ったってのは本当なのかい？」
dialogues.en: "I think... it's a miracle."
dialogues.text: "I think... it's a miracle."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、この前あった出来事を、先生に説明した。
（もちろん、｛・・・・・／一部は除く｝が）
dialogues.en: "That's not very scientific, is it?"
dialogues.text: "That's not very scientific, is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「それだけ、記憶が甦るってのも変な話さ」
dialogues.en:
"I can't think of anything else, though. If there is an
aircraft you can't identify, then it's a UFO, right?"
dialogues.text:
"I can't think of anything else, though. If there is an
aircraft you can't identify, then it's a UFO, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「結果的に『美春』の一番大切な思い出だった
　んですけど」
dialogues.en:
"But if that's a miracle, then God is cruel. It's cutting
her life short."
dialogues.text:
"But if that's a miracle, then God is cruel. It's cutting
her life short."

dialogues.jp: 先生が大きなため息をつく。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei sighs deeply.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei sighs deeply.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、あれが美春の望んでいたことですから。
　それに、美春はおかげでいろんなことが、わ
　かったって言ってますし」
dialogues.en:
"But that's what Miharu was hoping for. She's learned a lot
from the experience."
dialogues.text:
"But that's what Miharu was hoping for. She's learned a lot
from the experience."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「それでも天枷が満足してるならいいんだけど。
　ま、悲しがるのは、去りゆく者より残される
　者だからね」
dialogues.en:
"I have nothing left to say if Amakase is happy with it. But
the ones left behind are the ones who will feel the
saddest."
dialogues.text:
"I have nothing left to say if Amakase is happy with it. But
the ones left behind are the ones who will feel the
saddest."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「俺は……確かに割り切れない気持ちってのも
　ありますけど、それでも満足してます」
dialogues.en:
"Of course, I'm still confused, but at the same time I'm
satisfied."
dialogues.text:
"Of course, I'm still confused, but at the same time I'm
satisfied."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あいつと過ごせた期間は短かったけど、とて
　も大切なことを学んだ気がするし」
dialogues.en:
"We've only been together for a short amount of time, but I
learned something very important."
dialogues.text:
"We've only been together for a short amount of time, but I
learned something very important."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「思ったより強いね、朝倉は」
dialogues.en: "You're strong, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "You're strong, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「強くなんかぁないですよ。実際、美春がいな
　くなる時のことを考えると、今でも涙がこぼ
　れそうになりますよ」
dialogues.en:
"No, I'm not. Honestly, I feel like crying whenever I think
about Miharu not being in my life."
dialogues.text:
"No, I'm not. Honestly, I feel like crying whenever I think
about Miharu not being in my life."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「泣いたっていいじゃないか。それが普通だも
　の。堪えてたっていいこともないし」
dialogues.en:
"There's nothing wrong with crying. Holding emotions back
doesn't do any good."
dialogues.text:
"There's nothing wrong with crying. Holding emotions back
doesn't do any good."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そうですけどね」
dialogues.en: "I understand."
dialogues.text: "I understand."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「流した涙を｛かて／糧｝にできる人間は、強いのさ」
dialogues.en: "Men grow stronger through their tears."
dialogues.text: "Men grow stronger through their tears."

dialogues.jp: 先生のライターがカチンと鳴った。
dialogues.en: Then Koyomi-sensei makes a clicking sound with her lighter.
dialogues.text: Then Koyomi-sensei makes a clicking sound with her lighter.

dialogues.en: ◆Koyomi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Koyomi◆

dialogues.jp:
暦先生と美春の記憶について話した。先生が言
うには奇跡が起こったということらしい。そし
て、その奇跡は美春の命を縮めた。
dialogues.en: "I can't come here out of uniform."
dialogues.text: "I can't come here out of uniform."

dialogues.jp:
美春がいなくなる時のことを考えると、今でも
涙がこぼれそうになりますよ。
dialogues.en: "I don't mind."
dialogues.text: "I don't mind."

dialogues.jp:
そう告白した俺に、泣いたっていいじゃないか
と暦先生は答えた。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei puffs out cigarette smoke at me.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei puffs out cigarette smoke at me.

dialogues.speaker: 暦
dialogues.jp: 「流した涙を｛かて／糧｝にできる人間は、強いのさ」
dialogues.en:
"Cough... Cough... So Miharu is staying at home today,
right?"
dialogues.text:
"Cough... Cough... So Miharu is staying at home today,
right?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は強い人間になれるだろうか？
dialogues.en: "Yes, I made her take some rest as you requested."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I made her take some rest as you requested."
